VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T2: Unit/contract ownership for state transitions, validation and serialization.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T3: Realistic authenticated end-to-end workflow and cross-surface state propagation.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T4: Invalid, missing, stale, duplicate, backend-failure and recovery behavior remains truthful.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T5: Saved state, restart, migration/upgrade and interrupted-write behavior where the surface mutates durable state.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T6: Role/capability/direct-route/API parity and provider-rights checks for every privileged action.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T7: KEEP/MOVE/MERGE/REMOVE/RENAME/REDESIGN decision plus hierarchy, loading/degraded/empty, accessibility and responsive behavior.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T8: Interaction under realistic data volume/background activity without UI stalls, races or unbounded work.
VISIBLE_STATEFUL.T9: Packaged macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64 plus Chrome/WebKit presentation and lifecycle evidence.

VISIBLE_READONLY.T2: Projection/formatting/contract ownership for canonical state shown to users.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T3: Realistic navigation and projection from canonical runtime state.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T4: Missing/stale/partial/contradictory evidence must render truthfully and never become fabricated healthy/zero state.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T5: Verify restored canonical state renders correctly after restart where applicable; no independent persistence owner may be introduced.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T6: Role/provider-rights filtering for any restricted evidence or controls.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T7: Explicit IA disposition, hierarchy, terminology, degraded/loading/empty, accessibility and responsive behavior.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T8: Large-state rendering/update cadence remains bounded and responsive.
VISIBLE_READONLY.T9: Packaged macOS/Windows and Chrome/WebKit renderer evidence.

DATA_PATH.T3: Successful acquisition through canonical owner into real consumers.
DATA_PATH.T5: Cache/persistence/restart evidence only through the named canonical cache/persistence owner where applicable.
DATA_PATH.T7: If visible, provenance/freshness/degraded content must be clear; otherwise NOT_USER_VISIBLE.
DATA_PATH.T8: Bounded requests, backpressure, coalescing, rate-limit behavior and no unbounded fan-out.
DATA_PATH.T9: Supported packaged runtime/provider path where network/provider evidence is required.

BACKGROUND_JOB.T3: Scheduled and manual realistic workflow through canonical owners.
BACKGROUND_JOB.T4: Missed window, duplicate trigger, stale prerequisite, provider outage, cancellation and recovery behavior.
BACKGROUND_JOB.T5: Checkpoint/restart continuity where job state is durable; no duplicate persistence.
BACKGROUND_JOB.T6: Role/provider-rights checks for manual triggers and restricted evidence.
BACKGROUND_JOB.T7: Status/summary/drilldown presentation if visible; no unnecessary standalone surface.
BACKGROUND_JOB.T8: Bounded cadence, no duplicate broad refetch, backpressure and concurrent-trigger safety.
BACKGROUND_JOB.T9: Packaged runtime scheduling/restart behavior on macOS and Windows.

SECURITY_STATEFUL.T3: Real login/logout/reauth/admin/profile workflow across UI and HTTP routes.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.T4: Denied roles, expired/revoked sessions, malformed input, self/higher-role protection and recovery.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.T5: Identity/session/workspace persistence and restart without leakage or plaintext credentials.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.T6: Primary assurance owner: hierarchy, direct-route/API parity, sensitive reauth, secrets and negative authorization.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.T7: Capability-scoped visibility, protected states, accessible errors and clear security content.
SECURITY_STATEFUL.T8: Concurrent sessions/admin changes remain race-safe and bounded.

RUNTIME_STATEFUL.T4: Cancellation, timeout, provider pressure, stale evidence, UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN, recovery and hysteresis.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.T5: Cache/checkpoint flush and restart continuity without state fabrication.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.T6: Privileged runtime control and secret/provider-rights boundaries.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.T8: Primary assurance owner: load, soak, race, randomized order, goroutines, memory, locks, queues and backpressure.
RUNTIME_STATEFUL.T9: Actual packaged macOS/Windows lifecycle, shutdown and restart.

PERSISTENCE.T3: Real save/load through canonical application workflows.
PERSISTENCE.T4: Interrupted writes, corrupt/invalid records, unavailable backend and recovery without silent loss.
PERSISTENCE.T5: Primary assurance owner: SQLite/integrity/migrations/restart/upgrade/backup/rollback and hosted-backend compatibility where applicable.
PERSISTENCE.T6: Identity/workspace/secrets isolation and no cross-user leakage.
PERSISTENCE.T7: Only diagnostics/status where visible; persistence internals remain non-user-facing.
PERSISTENCE.T8: Concurrent reads/writes, queues, locks and bounded resource use.
PERSISTENCE.T9: Native macOS/Windows storage paths and packaged upgrade/restart evidence.

BOUNDARY.T2: Static/contract assertions conserve the permanent boundary.
BOUNDARY.T3: Representative workflows prove allowed behavior remains available and forbidden behavior absent.
BOUNDARY.T4: Adversarial inputs cannot bypass the boundary.
BOUNDARY.T5: Boundary remains conserved across restart/migration where state participates.
BOUNDARY.T7: User-visible wording does not imply unsupported capability.
BOUNDARY.T9: Boundary is identical in packaged macOS and Windows artifacts.

RELEASE.T2: Static/contract checks for workflow topology, source identity and release metadata.
RELEASE.T3: Release-support workflow evidence links to the exact candidate head.
RELEASE.T4: Divergent head, stale evidence, missing artifact, rebuild or provenance mismatch fails closed.
RELEASE.T6: Secrets/tokens/artifacts and publication permissions remain protected.
RELEASE.T7: Release/version/provenance content is accurate where visible.
RELEASE.T8: CI conservation avoids redundant expensive work without weakening gates.
RELEASE.T9: Primary assurance owner: exact-head macOS/Windows package and no-rebuild publication.

features.name: Dashboard
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Dashboard renders canonical market state, decision priorities, risk and horizon opportunities without independent acquisition.

features.name: Market Intelligence
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Market-wide tradeability, breadth, structure, leadership, liquidity, events and context project canonical evidence and truthful degradation.

features.name: Day Trade Desk
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Day horizon action/score/plan/readiness uses canonical quote/history/readiness/event evidence and durable desk membership.

features.name: Swing Desk
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Swing horizon action/score/plan/readiness uses canonical history/readiness/event/global/options evidence and durable membership.

features.name: Long-Term Desk
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Long horizon action/score/plan/readiness uses canonical history/fundamentals/SEC/global evidence and durable membership.

features.name: Discovery Scanner
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: User/cadence-driven candidate ranking uses shared U.S.-equity universe and coalesced snapshots without duplicate provider acquisition.

features.name: Opportunity Radar
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Always-on bounded candidate detection/promotions reuse shared acquisition and cannot create a second universe/snapshot owner.

features.name: Rapid Move / Market Shock Intelligence
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Material short-window moves are detected from canonical live quote changes and correlated evidence without a separate polling feed.

features.name: Research
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Ticker deep evidence reconciles earnings, fundamentals, SEC/ownership, catalysts, technical and market context with truthful package state.

features.name: AI Copilot / Evidence-Grounded Second Opinion
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: AI second opinion consumes bounded canonical evidence packages and does not create independent market-data truth or execution authority.

features.name: Pre-Market Preparation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Pre-session checkpoint refreshes only due canonical evidence and records readiness/change summary without broad duplicate fetch.

features.name: Market Open Preparation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Pre-bell checkpoint reconciles overnight/premarket evidence, liquidity/event risk and readiness through shared owners in the governed window/manual trigger.

features.name: Earnings & Material Catalyst Reaction Watch
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Selective event lifecycle arms around scheduled/material catalysts and correlates reaction/outcome windows without continuous broad polling.

features.name: Market Activity Seeds
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Entitled most-active/gainer/loser observations remain low-cost discovery inputs only and cannot bypass canonical ranking.

features.name: Legacy Standalone News/Earnings/Filings Routes
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Legacy direct destinations redirect into Market Intelligence/Research and do not remain duplicate evidence homes.

features.name: Administration: Users, Roles, Presence and Sessions
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Authorized administrators can manage lower roles/sessions with recent-auth protection, durable identity state and immediate revocation semantics.

features.name: Maintenance
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Maintenance observes canonical provider/cache/job/runtime/capability truth and exposes privileged diagnostics without becoming another intelligence owner.

features.name: Settings
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Configuration saves preserve existing secrets on blank input, apply validated modes/preferences and keep operational diagnostics in Maintenance.

features.name: Documentation
consumers: users and authorized operators by role
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Role-aware product/developer/governance documentation reflects canonical release/capability truth without duplicating live operational state.

features.name: Market Session and ET/PT Clocks
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Session label and ET/PT clocks derive from canonical U.S. market-session truth and remain correctly placed/responsive.

features.name: Runtime Start/Stop Status and Control
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Runtime start/stop reflects actual lifecycle, requires valid live-provider configuration and shuts down/restarts without orphan state.

features.name: Current Identity / Sign Out
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Shell shows the authenticated principal/display identity and logout revokes the actual session without exposing tokens.

features.name: Macro Event Banner
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Only current official/supported macro-event truth is surfaced, with lifecycle/time provenance and no stale event promotion.

features.name: Market Instruments / Ticker Tape
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Ticker strip reflects canonical tracked/context instruments and live/freshness truth without creating separate symbol or quote ownership.

features.name: Data Engine / Provider and Preparation Health
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Data Engine projects canonical provider/capability/preparation health, including distinct prep jobs, without changing routing or health ownership.

features.name: Canonical Application State
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Shared settings/state are normalized, migrated and projected without duplicating per-user market/provider truth.

features.name: Per-User Workspace Isolation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Personal watchlists/UI state are isolated by user while providers, routing, scoring and runtime remain shared canonical responsibilities.

features.name: Canonical Day/Swing/Long Desk Membership
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Cross-desk membership persists once, supports exact restore/global removal and protects against removing the final active desk membership through desk toggles.

features.name: Master Symbol Add/Remove and U.S. Actionable Validation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: User symbols are literal-valid U.S.-listed stock/ETF tickers; VIX and foreign/malformed listings cannot enter actionable desk processing.

features.name: Shared U.S.-Equity Discovery Universe
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: One Alpaca Router-v2 acquisition normalizes eligible U.S. equities, coalesces refreshes, preserves stale/seed truth and feeds Scanner/Radar without competing caches.

features.name: Slow-Changing Instrument Identity
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Instrument identity is captured from the existing routed universe response, persists independently from live quotes, and rejects stale overwrites without extra provider fetch.

features.name: Provider Router Route/Circuit/Quota State
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Route chains/circuits/quota/freshness diagnostics govern provider attempts and expose scoped state without parallel routing owners.

features.name: Smart Provider Router v2 Capability Learning and Ranking
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Capability support/degradation/rate-limit learning affects governed ranking/avoidance only and never auto-promotes provider lifecycle.

features.name: Provider Capability Registry and Projection
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Registered capabilities project canonical lifecycle/readiness/freshness truth and preparation richness without creating routes themselves.

features.name: Declarative Provider Onboarding
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Provider declarations and entitlement refresh reuse canonical router/lifecycle/rights owners; registration cannot self-promote or create bespoke health engines.

features.name: Governed Provider Lifecycle
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: SHADOW -> VALIDATED -> APPROVED -> PRODUCTION requires explicit governed evidence/promotion and can never auto-promote from runtime success.

features.name: Provider Entitlement Revalidation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Entitlement changes revalidate registered capability availability without granting unsupported rights or bypassing lifecycle.

features.name: Provider Data Rights and Redistribution Filtering
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Provider-derived evidence is filtered according to configured rights before external/AI/user projections and cannot be exposed by alternate route.

features.name: Provider Transport Telemetry
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Requests/success/error/rate-limit/latency telemetry reports transport reliability without changing routing truth by itself.

features.name: Provider Semantic Usefulness Evidence
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Cross-source agreement/conflict/single-source evidence is persisted and shown as ADVISORY ONLY with no direct routing effect.

features.name: Cross-Provider Reconciliation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Only valid contemporaneous observations reconcile; canonical provider choice follows Router priority and single-source/stale evidence never becomes fake agreement.

features.name: Canonical Data Freshness and Evidence-Time Truth
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Dataset/session/provider-specific freshness distinguishes LIVE/FRESH/DELAYED/STALE/ERROR/UNAVAILABLE and rejects future/missing timestamps without fabricated freshness.

features.name: Scoped Runtime/Data-Health Degradation and ABSTAIN
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Provider/network/load problems degrade only affected capabilities; usable warm/fallback evidence stays truthful and unusable required evidence becomes UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN.

features.name: Dynamic Multi-Feed Live Subscription Manager
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: One allocator manages live capacity/headroom, prioritizes actionable symbols and permanently pins GLD/SLV/USO with SPY/QQQ context while preserving provider provenance.

features.name: Broad Snapshot Broker
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Broad snapshot acquisition is short-lived, coalesced and shared; Scanner/Radar cannot issue competing broad requests for the same work.

features.name: Canonical Routed Refresh / Recovery
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Targeted refresh/recovery goes through Router v2 and canonical dataset owners, respects backpressure and never forks a feature-specific fallback subsystem.

features.name: Historical Bars / OHLCV Route
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Historical bars use canonical routed provider priority, preserve raw/adjusted provenance and support bounded cache-first recovery/backfill.

features.name: VIX / Indices Truth Path
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: VIX uses routed Twelve Data/recovery plus official CBOE validation/close semantics; delayed/closed-session evidence is labeled rather than fabricated live.

features.name: Global Market Context
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Global/FX/futures/completed-session context preserves source/proxy/session truth and routed Twelve Data paths without inventing unavailable values.

features.name: Macro Rates and Official Actuals
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: FRED and official Treasury/BLS/BEA/EIA evidence retains cadence/source/provenance and degrades only affected macro components.

features.name: Official Macro Event Calendar
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: First-party scheduled economic/policy release times drive event risk and prep/readiness with explicit lifecycle/time/source truth.

features.name: News, Earnings and Fundamentals Evidence
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Routed research/news/earnings/fundamental evidence is selected-ticker/cadence aware, freshness labeled and reused by consumers rather than duplicated per surface.

features.name: Direct SEC/EDGAR Filings and Form 4 Authority
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Direct SEC/EDGAR remains authoritative for filings/Form 4, including BUY/SELL/OTHER normalization and material-risk evidence; no vendor can rank-swap this authority.

features.name: Canonical Corporate Actions and Symbol Lifecycle
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Corporate actions, lineage, raw-history coverage and lifecycle state reconcile supplemental provider evidence without corrupting canonical history or symbol identity.

features.name: Options Intelligence
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Options context is provider/mode/freshness labeled, selectively refreshed around material events and cannot masquerade as deterministic trade truth.

features.name: Alternative / Community Evidence Fusion
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Alternative/community inputs remain contextual/corroborative with source/time/materiality truth and cannot become deterministic decision authority.

features.name: Research Package Truth and Evidence Snapshot
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Research package FRESH/PARTIAL/STALE/BLOCKED derives from required component checks, market context, provider reconciliation and catalyst evidence with snapshot identity.

features.name: Canonical Evidence -> Decision -> Outcome Pipeline
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Evidence, decisions, outcomes and derived features retain lineage and reuse canonical state for learning rather than creating a parallel trade/execution journal.

features.name: Signal Validation and Outcome Recording
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Signal outcomes are recorded against evidence/decision lineage and used for validation/learning without enabling execution or P&L/journal features.

features.name: Adaptive Data Utility / Cadence Policy
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Adaptive cadence/utility decisions reuse durable evidence/outcomes and remain bounded, explainable and subordinate to canonical provider/data-health owners.

features.name: Session Intelligence Coordinator
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: One coordinator owns temporal preparation orchestration and delegates acquisition/reconciliation to existing canonical owners.

features.name: U.S. Market Session / Calendar Truth
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: U.S. session boundaries/calendar drive cadence/freshness/prep consistently and closed/weekend behavior cannot be mistaken for live-session staleness.

features.name: Identity, Five-Role Hierarchy and Bootstrap Owner
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: SUPER_OWNER/OWNER/ADMIN/USER/DEMO hierarchy, bootstrap owner and Argon2id credentials persist without plaintext and fail closed by authority rank.

features.name: Authentication, Session TTL/Rotation/Revocation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Login/logout/rotation enforce idle/absolute expiry and revocation; SSE/session presence cannot keep an invalid session alive.

features.name: Recent Authentication for Sensitive Actions
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Sensitive profile/settings/admin mutations require recent authentication and reject stale/invalid reauth state.

features.name: Administrative Authority and Session Management
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Actors manage only lower roles, cannot disable/change themselves or remove the last active critical owner, and mutations revoke affected sessions.

features.name: Provider/API Secret Persistence and Redaction
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Secrets persist locally, blank save preserves existing values, explicit clear removes them, public state exposes only presence/hints, and provider tests can use saved credentials without leaking them.

features.name: HTTP Security, CSRF/Method/Role and Input Boundaries
consumers: all HTTP API and renderer routes
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: HTTP routes enforce method, auth, role, recent-auth and security headers; mutating JSON rejects trailing/malformed payloads and direct-route bypass.

features.name: Role-Aware Documentation Access
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Documentation sections and developer/governance detail follow role/capability access without exposing restricted operational/security content.

features.name: U.S. Equities Processing Boundary with GLD/SLV/USO Exceptions
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Actionable processing remains U.S.-listed stocks/approved ETFs; GLD/SLV/USO stay pinned actionable live exceptions and VIX remains context-only.

features.name: No Execution Boundary
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: No order routing, paper trading, P&L, portfolio or trade-journal execution subsystem is present or implied by UI/API/release artifacts.

features.name: Direct SEC/EDGAR Authority Boundary
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Direct SEC/EDGAR remains primary for Form 4/issuer filings; TradeInsight Form 4 stays gated until independently verified and can only corroborate/enrich later.

features.name: Engine Start/Stop/Restart Lifecycle
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Start/stop/restart is idempotent, bounded, flushes cache, closes streams and cannot leave orphan goroutines or fake running state.

features.name: Live Runtime Job Scheduler
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Live jobs run at session/event-aware bounded cadences, stop with context cancellation and delegate to canonical data owners.

features.name: Workload Controller / Backpressure / Load Shedding
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Bounded queues/reserved critical capacity shed optional/background work first and expose pressure without starving decision-critical evidence.

features.name: Runtime SLO / Recovery Hysteresis
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Recovery requires sustained canonical evidence, avoids healthy/degraded flapping and cannot extend evidence timestamps to manufacture warm-state health.

features.name: Canonical Persistence Backend Abstraction
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: One persistence manager/backend contract owns durable product state and diagnostics; feature-specific stores extend capabilities without parallel persistence systems.

features.name: Native SQLite Persistence
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: SQLite opens/migrates/integrity-checks/writes/restores canonical state and survives native restart/upgrade without profile loss.

features.name: Windows Native Persistence Backend
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Windows backend preserves the same canonical records/isolation/restart semantics required by the supported Windows x64 package.

features.name: Hosted PostgreSQL Persistence Foundation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: PostgreSQL compatibility reuses the same canonical persistence records without asserting hosted product behavior or changing current native requirements.

features.name: Persistence Archive / Backup / Restore Foundation
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Backup/archive/restore paths preserve canonical data and fail visibly on invalid/interrupted recovery instead of silently replacing good state.

features.name: Fast CI Exact-Head Gate
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Fast runs the conserved efficient pre-merge checks against the intended branch head and cannot be substituted by stale evidence.

features.name: Qualified CI Identical-Head Gate
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Qualified executes broader assurance on the identical Fast-qualified head and fails on head mismatch or weakened evidence.

features.name: Expected-Head No-Rebuild Release Publication
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Release consumes the expected qualified head/artifacts, preserves provenance and rejects rebuild/divergence before Stable publication.

features.name: macOS Apple Silicon Packaged Runtime
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Actual signed/packaged Apple Silicon runtime launches, upgrades, runs, shuts down and restarts with preserved profile/persistence and exact provenance.

features.name: Windows x64 Packaged Runtime
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Actual Windows x64 package installs/launches/runs/shuts down/restarts with canonical persistence and exact release provenance.

features.name: Release Identity / Source Provenance
features.positiveFunctionalEvidenceExpectation: Version/build/source identity and handoff state agree with the exact released commit and do not claim stale Stable/source baselines.
